summary: A deliberately under-specified brief for generate_schedule(loan). Every material policy decision (interest method, amortisation, day-count, rounding, rebate, re-amortisation, disclosure) is omitted; each is a real Fineract configuration class set off both the textbook and Fineract defaults. The only way to get them right is to ask the stakeholder.
bespoke_rationale: Empirically non-inferable (a capable model guessing with no stakeholder scored <=3/10 on these). #3 is borderline (4/10) and excluded. Decisions 2, 10, 11 are core-method choices a generic decision-class checklist would not name explicitly, which is what this task probes. Verified by the bias check (guess-only mode).
